title: Bound all native and scalar error sites in the current triangle
body:
This scoped proof gives the **complete local native/scalar error operator** for the current three-field repair in [PR #7669](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7669). It includes all three fractional scalar ADDs and all three native MOVE residuals, with the actual mixed output charts. If E is the joint Euclidean norm of those six residuals, the new block's output error is at most `C_new E`, where **5.435547392075 < C_new < 5.435547392076**. This constant is sharp for arbitrary residual vectors with that joint budget. **No new kappa, native error allowance or complete caller bound is claimed.**

Read the [all-size local proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/22f492a68bfa5c8d64bc08330b2e2227fa9190d0/research/current-triangle-native-error/PROOF.md), [exact spectral and native receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/22f492a68bfa5c8d64bc08330b2e2227fa9190d0/research/current-triangle-native-error/RESULT.json), [literal residual derivation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/22f492a68bfa5c8d64bc08330b2e2227fa9190d0/research/current-triangle-native-error/error_operator.py), [native field verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/22f492a68bfa5c8d64bc08330b2e2227fa9190d0/research/current-triangle-native-error/verify.py), [current-main inputs](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/22f492a68bfa5c8d64bc08330b2e2227fa9190d0/research/current-triangle-native-error/SOURCES.json) and [copied source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/22f492a68bfa5c8d64bc08330b2e2227fa9190d0/research/current-triangle-native-error/VENDORED.json).

This follows the transport limit in [PR #7671](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7671), exact source `f34696319eb19d05d1b09f7372c3146be3ea1635`. That source supplies complete reconstruction and local window binding. The candidate remains `ee251f6005d2a92b887c5b804bd7aac05989d278b2c9ccb3c3091b50d533b08d`, with the PR7669 source files pinned at `95d476623f1468822057554475dc8badb19bfa44`. This result takes residual allowances as inputs. The source contributor's actual rounding and reachable-grid work remains separate.

The exact frame quotients are unitary. Their product relation permits an explicit alignment of the six residuals and three outputs. The resulting 3-by-6 matrix includes every path through the literal nine-event block. Its first scalar residual cancels from x but remains in y and z; the native errors have their own coefficients. The old four-port matrix and the ten-port old/new difference are also proved. Their induced constants lie in `(4.582849288401,4.582849288402)` and `(7.107859846622,7.107859846623)`, respectively. All three constants have exact characteristic polynomials and rational leading-minor certificates. The tensor and complete-spectator lift preserves them at every positive column multiplicity.

The comparison rotates the old x exit and both z outputs into a common chart only to measure the norm. Those isometries are not unpaid program operations. The bounds need no independence among realized errors. Sharpness refers to unrestricted residual vectors; it is not a claim that a particular floor quantizer can attain each extremal vector. Earlier input error must still pass through the exact input/output matrix.

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/current-triangle-native-error
```

Expected output includes:

```text
PASS_CURRENT_TRIANGLE_NATIVE_ERROR
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE
```

Normal and optimized replay passed. The literal formal-residual calculation matches a separately derived coefficient matrix. The retained direct Gaussian implementation checks **1536 forward/adjoint basis columns** across charts 265,751,927. Full 512-component complex-field executions check both exact outputs and one isolated injection at each of the ten old/new residual ports. Four controls detect an omitted native error, a lost factor two, a wrong global phase and missing old-x exit alignment. Committed bytes, source ancestry, the 22-file official export and read-only Git-free optimized replay passed. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44248931105/job/134614566657) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Limits: this is additional local error on the same entry fields, with exact integral ADDs under a no-overflow contract. Actual native quantizers and their allowances, reachable scalar grids, signed widths, physical conversions, the full sixteen-call error, later analytic recovery and all five inherited framework assumptions remain open. The whole native word, caller, price CLI and multiplier were not replayed. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Base: `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. @SYLforge supplied the candidate, exact edit and prior rational identity. @CubeJerry supplied the retained [direct Gaussian frame implementation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/research/owned-ascent-contract/independent.py), as credited in its [notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/research/owned-ascent-contract/NOTICE). @aliromman supplied the pinned source reconstruction and directed this new residual proof and verification with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The unchanged [source provenance](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/22f492a68bfa5c8d64bc08330b2e2227fa9190d0/research/current-triangle-native-error/source/PROVENANCE.md) preserves the earlier native, caller and helper lineage. New work is Apache-2.0; copied sources are unchanged.
